system.description:
Deal [2D + (Attack Power)]  physical damage to the target.

(Successful Hit): Give target [Weakness (Magic): 10]. Treat this [Weakness] as a Bad status.

(CR 16): The [Weakness] increases to 15. 
(Fate 1): The strength of [Weakness] is doubled.

A special skill that envelops poisonous-colored spores in weapon attacks and erodes the target's body with the blow. Enemies infested with spores lose much of their resistance to magic.
